pr_title: kvserver: skip decommissioning test under metamorphic builds
pr_body:
Similar to the issue found in #99207, it was discovered that `TestDecommission` is also failing due to #100783 - under metamorphic builds, mux range feeds (among other settings) are enabled, which cause span config updates (which depend on range feeds) to fail. As can be seen in the test, this causes expectations on things such as the replication factor applied to a range to fail due to being out-of-date. Until #100783 is fixed, this changes `TestDecommission` to be skipped under metamorphic builds; stressing this test has shown that it succeeds repeatedly when in a non-metamorphic build.

Fixes: #96630

Release note: None
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/101882)
